newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville raises firm peak Northwest power prices.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville raises firm peak Northwest power prices.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised its next-day price offers for firm power by 50 cents per megawatt hour (MWh), and refrained from offering any firm power during light-load hours for Thursday, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA also slightly lowered its prices for non-firm next-day power.
For Thursday, BPA offered up to 400 megawatts of power during heavy load hours at $23.50 in the Northwest and $25.00 at the California-Oregon (COB) and Nevada-Oregon (NOB) borders.
Non-firm power for delivery between 0100 and 0500 and the hour ending 2400 PST on Thursday was offered at $18.00 for all deliveries.
BPA offerd non-firm power during peak hours on Thursday at $19.00 for all deliveries.
